title: Who's Coming For Dinner?
html: Everyone gets a spot — Can you figure out who sits where? —

title: Polar Express Cryptogram
html: Pick a favorite Christmas movie, grab some snacks, and enjoy a festive night in.

title: Carol Crossword
html: Make yourself a warm drink — cocoa, tea, or coffee — and savor a quiet moment.

html: Do one small act of kindness today. It can be as simple as a smile or a kind message.

title: Reindeer Seek & Find
html: Put on your favorite Christmas music and let it fill your space with cheer.

html: Bake cookies, brownies, or a festive treat — or simply enjoy one you love.

html: Add a little Christmas cheer somewhere — a decoration, lights, or even your desk.

html: Look through old holiday photos or reflect on a favorite Christmas memory.

title: Word Scramble
html: Dim the lights, light a candle, and enjoy a peaceful, cozy evening.

title: Movie Emoji
html: Write down three things you’re grateful for this season.

title: Find The Hidden Word
html: Send a message or call someone you haven’t talked to in a while.

title: Merry Christmas 🎄
html: Merry Christmas! I hope your day is filled with warmth, love, and joy.
